player_prompt.intro:
Ndiwe Mchezaji {player_id} mchezo wa Indian Poker.
- Deki la khadi 52; unamuona mchezaji mwingine khadi yake.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) kila zamu, {max_rounds} zamu zote.
- Mipigo halali: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ni nambari chanya <= idadi ya chip zako.)
- Khadi iliyojificha ya juu hushinda poti kwenye kipindi cha mwisho.
